users.sensitivityThreshold: Sensitivity threshold for leak detection. Lower values detect smaller leaks but may produce more false positives.
users.numberOfPeriods: Number of periods to analyze. For example, if period is 'week' and count is 2, it analyzes the last 2 weeks.
users.riskScoreTooltip: Risk score from 0-100 indicating likelihood of leaks. Higher scores require immediate attention.
users.suspiciousDaysTooltip: Number of days with leak indicators detected.
users.suspiciousDaysPercentageTooltip: Percentage of analyzed days that show suspicious leak patterns. Calculated as: (suspicious days / total days analyzed) × 100. Higher percentages indicate more widespread leak issues.
users.consecutiveLeakDaysTooltip: Maximum number of consecutive days with leak indicators. Higher values indicate ongoing leaks.
users.baselineMetricsTooltip: Baseline metrics calculated from the first portion of data. Used as reference for detecting anomalies.
users.leakPatternsTooltip: Types of leak patterns identified in the data.
users.riskDistributionTooltip: Distribution of days by risk level (High, Medium, Low).
users.leakRiskScoreOverTimeTooltip: Shows daily leak risk scores. Higher scores indicate stronger leak indicators.
users.consumptionVsFlowRateTooltip: Compares consumption and flow rate. Discrepancies may indicate leaks.
users.leakIndicatorsTooltip: Detailed leak indicators for each day with suspicious patterns.
users.consumptionTrendsTooltip: Shows consumption trends over the selected period. Includes total, average, maximum, and minimum consumption values.
users.flowRateAnalysisTooltip: Shows flow rate trends including average, maximum, and minimum flow rates over the selected period.
users.forecastTooltip: Predicts future water consumption based on historical data using linear regression. Shows forecasted values with confidence intervals.
users.rSquaredTooltip: R-squared measures how well the forecast model fits the data. Higher values (closer to 1) indicate better predictions.
users.meanAbsoluteErrorTooltip: Average difference between predicted and actual values. Lower values indicate more accurate forecasts.
users.meanAbsolutePercentageErrorTooltip: Average percentage error of predictions. Shows forecast accuracy as a percentage.
users.forecastedConsumptionTooltip: Predicted consumption value for this date
users.correlationTooltip: Shows relationships between different consumption metrics. Correlation coefficient ranges from -1 to +1, where values closer to ±1 indicate stronger relationships.
users.correlationCoefficientTooltip: Correlation coefficient ranging from -1 to +1. Values closer to +1 indicate strong positive correlation, values closer to -1 indicate strong negative correlation, and values near 0 indicate no correlation.
users.seasonalityTooltip: Identifies recurring patterns in consumption across different time periods (months, weeks, or days). Helps understand when consumption is typically higher or lower.
users.deviationTooltip: Difference from overall average. Positive values indicate above-average consumption.
users.percentDeviationTooltip: Percentage difference from overall average consumption. Positive values indicate above-average consumption, negative values indicate below-average consumption.
users.benchmarkTooltip: Compares this user's consumption against the average of all users. Helps identify if consumption is above, below, or at average levels.
users.differenceTooltip: Absolute difference between your consumption and the benchmark average
users.percentDifferenceTooltip: Percentage difference from benchmark. Positive means above average, negative means below average.
users.riskAssessmentTooltip: Identifies potential risks and anomalies in water consumption patterns. Helps detect unusual usage, approaching limits, and consumption trends that may require attention.
users.riskScoreTooltip: Overall risk score from 0-100. Higher scores indicate higher risk levels requiring attention.
users.limitUtilizationTooltip: Percentage of consumption limit currently being used. Values above 90% indicate approaching limit.
users.howManyStandardDeviations: How much the consumption deviates from the average
users.statisticalMeasure: Statistical measure of how many standard deviations away from the mean. Values > 2 indicate significant anomalies.
users.performanceMetricsTooltip: Comprehensive performance analysis including consumption metrics, efficiency, consistency, and trends. Provides an overall performance score.
users.performanceScoreTooltip: Overall performance score from 0-100. Based on consumption consistency, efficiency, and trends.
users.coefficientOfVariationTooltip: Measures variability relative to the mean. Lower values indicate more consistent consumption.
users.pumpEfficiencyTooltip: Analyzes pump performance and efficiency metrics. Measures water delivery per pump cycle, flow efficiency, and overall pump utilization.
users.avgConsumptionPerCycleTooltip: Average water consumption per pump cycle. Higher values indicate better efficiency.
users.pumpUtilizationRateTooltip: Percentage of time the pump is actively cycling. High utilization may indicate overuse.
users.pumpCycleAnalysisTooltip: Analyzes pump on/off patterns and cycles. Identifies excessive cycling, weekday vs weekend patterns, and cycle efficiency.
users.pumpHealthMonitoringTooltip: Comprehensive pump health assessment including efficiency, reliability, and performance metrics. Provides overall health score and trend analysis.
users.healthScoreTooltip: Health score from 0-100. Based on efficiency, reliability, and performance metrics.
users.pumpOperationOptimizationTooltip: Provides recommendations for optimizing pump operation to improve efficiency, reduce wear, and lower energy consumption.
users.customDateRangeEnabled: Select specific start and end dates
users.groupByPeriodTooltip: Select how to group the data for seasonal analysis (by month, week, or day)
users.seasonalVariationTooltip: Difference between highest and lowest consumption periods
users.seasonalityStrengthTooltip: Indicates if there is a strong seasonal pattern (variation > 20%)
users.seasonalPatternChartTooltip: Shows consumption patterns across different periods
users.recordCountTooltip: Number of data points in this period
users.stdDeviationTooltip: Standard deviation of consumption. Higher values indicate more variability in consumption patterns. Used to identify anomalies (values more than 2 standard deviations from average).
users.currentConsumptionTooltip: Most recent consumption value in the selected period. This is the latest daily consumption recorded.
users.consumptionLimitTooltip: Maximum allowed consumption limit for the user. This is the daily limit set for water consumption.
users.statisticsOverviewTooltip: Key statistical measures used for risk assessment, including average consumption, standard deviation, and limit utilization.
users.consumptionTooltip: Actual consumption value on this date
users.zScoreTooltip: Statistical measure indicating how many standard deviations the consumption is from the average. Values above 2 or below -2 indicate anomalies. Higher absolute values indicate more extreme deviations.
users.anomalyTypeTooltip: Type of anomaly: 'spike' indicates unusually high consumption, 'drop' indicates unusually low consumption
users.identifiedRisksTooltip: Risks identified based on consumption patterns, trends, and limit utilization. Each risk includes severity level, type, description, and recommendations.
users.anomaliesTooltip: Consumption values that deviate significantly from the average (more than 2 standard deviations). Spikes indicate unusually high consumption, drops indicate unusually low consumption.
users.riskScoreTooltip: Overall risk score from 0-100. Calculated based on identified risks: High severity risks add 30 points, medium severity risks add 15 points, and low severity risks add 5 points. Higher scores indicate greater risk.
users.anomaliesDetectedTooltip: Number of consumption anomalies detected (consumption deviating more than 2 standard deviations from average). Only the top 10 anomalies are shown.
users.limitUtilizationTooltip: Percentage of consumption limit currently being used. Calculated as: (current consumption / consumption limit) × 100. Values above 90% indicate high risk of exceeding limit.
users.totalPeriodsTooltip: Total number of time periods (days, weeks, months, or years) included in the analysis. Each period represents aggregated consumption data for that time frame.
users.totalConsumptionTooltip: Sum of all daily consumption values (in liters) across all periods in the selected date range. This represents the total water consumed during the entire period.
users.avgPerPeriodTooltip: Average consumption per time period. Calculated by dividing total consumption by the number of periods. Helps understand typical consumption per period.
users.maxPeriodTooltip: The period with the highest total consumption value. Shows the peak consumption period in the selected date range.
users.projectionsTooltip: Future consumption predictions based on historical data trends. Uses linear regression to forecast upcoming periods.
users.nextPeriodForecastTooltip: Predicted consumption value (in liters) for the next time period based on historical trends and growth patterns.
users.growthRateTooltip: Percentage rate of consumption growth or decline. Positive values indicate increasing consumption, negative values indicate decreasing consumption.
users.confidenceTooltip: Confidence level of the forecast (high, medium, or low). Based on data quality and historical consistency. Higher confidence means more reliable predictions.
users.totalRecordsTooltip: Total number of consumption records or data points included in the analysis. Each record represents one time period's aggregated data.
users.overallAvgConsumptionTooltip: Average of all average consumption values across all periods. This is the mean of period averages, providing an overall consumption rate.
users.overallTotalConsumptionTooltip: Sum of all total consumption values from all periods. Represents the cumulative water consumption across the entire analysis period.
users.maxConsumptionTooltip: The highest total consumption value found across all periods in the analysis. Indicates peak consumption.
users.minConsumptionTooltip: The lowest total consumption value found across all periods in the analysis. Indicates minimum consumption.
users.totalGrowthPercentTooltip: Overall percentage change in consumption from the first period to the last period. Calculated as: ((last - first) / first) × 100. Positive means growth, negative means decline.
users.trendMagnitudeTooltip: Strength of the consumption trend measured by the absolute value of the slope from linear regression. Higher values indicate stronger trends (steeper increases or decreases).
users.consumptionDifferenceTooltip: Absolute difference in consumption between two consecutive periods. Calculated as: current period consumption - previous period consumption. Positive values mean consumption increased.
users.percentChangeTooltip: Percentage change in consumption between two consecutive periods. Calculated as: ((current - previous) / previous) × 100. Positive values indicate increase, negative values indicate decrease.
users.cyclesPerDayTooltip: Average number of pump cycles (on/off cycles) per day. Calculated by dividing total status changes by the number of days. Higher values indicate more frequent pump operation.
users.anomaliesDetectedTooltip: Number of statistical anomalies detected. Anomalies are consumption values that deviate more than 2 standard deviations from the mean, indicating unusual consumption patterns.
users.dataPointsTooltip: Total number of data points (consumption records) used in the performance analysis. More data points generally provide more reliable analysis results.
users.avgConsumptionTooltip: Average daily consumption value (in liters) calculated from all consumption records in the selected period. Represents typical daily water usage.
users.maxFlowRateTooltip: Maximum flow rate value (in L/min) recorded during the selected period. Indicates peak water flow.
users.minFlowRateTooltip: Minimum flow rate value (in L/min) recorded during the selected period. Indicates lowest water flow.
users.avgFlowRateTooltip: Average flow rate (in L/min) calculated from all flow rate measurements in the period. Represents typical water flow speed during the period.
users.avgStatusChangesTooltip: Average number of pump status changes (on/off cycles) per day during the baseline period. Used as a reference for detecting unusual pump activity patterns.
users.totalReadingsTooltip: Total number of sensor readings collected during this period. Each reading represents a measurement point. More readings provide more detailed data.
users.totalCyclesTooltip: Total number of pump cycles (on/off status changes) across all days in the analysis period. Each cycle represents one pump activation.
users.avgCyclesPerDayTooltip: Average number of pump cycles per day. Calculated by dividing total cycles by the number of days. Helps identify pump usage frequency.
users.resetToCycleRatioTooltip: Percentage of pump cycles that are resets. Calculated as: (total resets / total cycles) × 100. Higher values may indicate control system issues.
users.weekdayCyclesTooltip: Average number of pump cycles on weekdays (Monday-Friday). Helps identify usage patterns between weekdays and weekends.
users.weekendCyclesTooltip: Average number of pump cycles on weekends (Saturday-Sunday). Helps identify usage patterns between weekdays and weekends.
users.avgConsumptionPerDayTooltip: Average daily water consumption (in liters) calculated across all days in the analysis period. Represents typical daily usage.
users.efficiencyScoreTooltip: Overall efficiency score (0-100) based on pump operation metrics. Higher scores indicate better efficiency. Considers cycling frequency, consumption per cycle, and flow rate stability.
users.efficiencyStatusTooltip: Pump efficiency status based on water delivery per cycle. Excellent: >50L/cycle, Good: 25-50L/cycle, Fair: 10-25L/cycle, Poor: <10L/cycle.
users.reliabilityStatusTooltip: Pump reliability status based on reset rate. Excellent: <5%, Good: 5-10%, Fair: 10-20%, Poor: >20%. Lower reset rates indicate more stable operation.
users.performanceStatusTooltip: Pump performance status based on average flow rate. Excellent: >50 L/min, Good: 25-50 L/min, Fair: 10-25 L/min, Poor: <10 L/min.
users.resetRateTooltip: Percentage of pump cycles that are resets. Calculated as: (total resets / total cycles) × 100. High reset rates may indicate control system instability or pressure issues.
users.avgFlowTooltip: Average flow rate (in L/min) during pump operation. Represents typical water flow speed when the pump is active.
users.usersInComparisonTooltip: Total number of users included in the benchmark comparison. This represents the sample size used to calculate the average consumption benchmark.
users.stabilityTooltip: Consumption stability level based on coefficient of variation. Very stable: <10%, Stable: 10-20%, Moderate: 20-30%, Variable: >30%. Lower values indicate more consistent consumption patterns.
users.growthRateTooltip: Percentage change in consumption between the first half and second half of the analysis period. Positive values indicate increasing consumption, negative values indicate decreasing consumption.
